mechanism_narrative: Higher monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and construction activity, which typically precedes improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a stable economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to weak consumer spending and corporate profit pressures, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO exceeds its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 144,000 thousand, it signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 144,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST > 1080 and RSAFS > 450000) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), the S&P 500 tends to decline due to central bank tightening and reduced real earnings, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0.
